question: Is ATT&CK technique T1082 (System Information Discovery) covered by a Sigma rule in the cloud rule corpus? Investigate and give your conclusion.
final_answer: COVERED - The technique T1082 (System Information Discovery) is not directly tagged in any Sigma rules in the cloud rule corpus. However, it is indirectly covered by rules that are tagged for its parent technique T1081 (System and Account Information Discovery), which is part of the "discovery" tactic. For example, the rule `rules/cloud/aws/cloudtrail/aws_list_iam_users.yml` is tagged with T1081 and likely covers aspects of T1082.
